description: Defines the CryptoFramer class and related interfaces for framing and parsing cryptographic handshake messages in QUIC protocol, including visitor interface, error handling, and message construction.

classes.name: CryptoFramer
classes.description: Handles framing and parsing of cryptographic handshake messages in QUIC, manages state, errors, and visitor callbacks.

classes.name: CryptoFramerVisitorInterface
classes.description: Interface for callbacks when errors occur or handshake messages are parsed.

methods.name: ParseMessage
methods.description: Parses exactly one handshake message from input data.

methods.name: error_detail
methods.description: Returns details about the last error.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data for parsing, with optional encryption level.

methods.name: HasTag
methods.description: Checks if a specific tag has been seen in the message.

methods.name: ForceHandshake
methods.description: Forces processing of the handshake message even if incomplete.

methods.name: ConstructHandshakeMessage
methods.description: Serializes a handshake message into QuicData.

methods.name: set_process_truncated_messages
methods.description: Enables processing of truncated messages for debugging.
